scope: Persist a separately reviewed current career-story citation with its reviewed application-answer export and expose provenance in profile-scoped document history without changing answer text or TXT bytes.

integrated_main.method: local non-force fast-forward under the Codex integration lock

connected_api_and_browser.summary: 4 API integration tests and 1 connected Chromium workflow passed. Current approved revision and exact fact fingerprints are required; stale, tampered, and sensitive-question citations are rejected before export. The browser explicitly reviews and selects a citation, exports a reviewed answer, reloads profile-scoped document history, verifies source-fact IDs, confirms TXT bytes contain only the answer text, and records no external requests.

related_python_regressions.summary: 41 existing export, answer-matching, durable story-bank, and story-selection tests passed.

frontend_tests.command: npm run test --prefix apps/web -- --run src/application-story-reference-workspace.test.tsx src/application-answer-matching.test.tsx src/application-answer-matching-client.test.ts src/document-history.test.tsx

frontend_build.summary: TypeScript and Vite production build passed; the existing large-chunk advisory remains.

limitations: Citation provenance is appended in a separate audit transaction immediately after the immutable answer-export transaction; an interruption between those commits could leave an export without its citation record.
Story citations are not yet selectable for resume or cover-letter generation, so MJ-REF-002 remains PARTIAL.
PostgreSQL, hosted verification, and full-repository regression were not run.
